command:
set -u
export ANDROID_HOME="/Users/kelvin/Library/Android/sdk"
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/24.9.0/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/codex-path:/usr/bin:/bin"
export TMPDIR="/tmp"
export CI=1
export NO_COLOR=1
SOURCE_ROOT="/Users/kelvin/VibeCoding-WorkSpace/InnovativeNovels"
ADB="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb"
TASK_FAILURES=0
TASK_LAST_STATUS=0
TASK_EMULATOR_PID=""
TASK_EMULATOR_READY=0
FULL_VITEST_STATUS=125
PRODUCTION_BUILD_STATUS=125
ANDROID_ASSET_COPY_STATUS=125
PID_SMOKE_STATUS=125
PID_CAPTURE_STATUS=125
PID_PERSISTENCE_STATUS=125
PID_READBACK_STATUS=125
PROCESS_RESTART_STATUS=125
ANDROID_NATIVE_STATUS=125
READER_RESUME_STATUS=125
DIFF_CHECK_STATUS=125

run_step() {
  local task_step_name="$1"
  shift
  printf "\n=== STEP START: %s ===\n" "$task_step_name"
  if "$@"; then
    TASK_LAST_STATUS=0
  else
    TASK_LAST_STATUS=$?
  fi
  printf "=== STEP END: %s EXIT_STATUS=%s ===\n" "$task_step_name" "$TASK_LAST_STATUS"
  if [ "$TASK_LAST_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
    TASK_FAILURES=$((TASK_FAILURES + 1))
  fi
}

wait_for_emulator() {
  local attempt device_state boot_state
  for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
    device_state="$("$ADB" -s emulator-5554 get-state 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ "$device_state" = "device" ]; then
      boot_state="$("$ADB" -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n' || true)"
      if [ "$boot_state" = "1" ]; then
        TASK_EMULATOR_READY=1
        printf "ANDROID_EMULATOR_BOOT=PASS AVD=Wave11_Android35 DEVICE=emulator-5554\n"
        return 0
      fi
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  printf "ANDROID_EMULATOR_BOOT=FAIL AVD=Wave11_Android35 DEVICE=emulator-5554\n"
  return 1
}

stop_emulator() {
  if [ -z "$TASK_EMULATOR_PID" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  printf "\n=== EMULATOR SHUTDOWN START ===\n"
  "$ADB" -s emulator-5554 emu kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  local attempt
  for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
    if ! kill -0 "$TASK_EMULATOR_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      break
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  if kill -0 "$TASK_EMULATOR_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "$TASK_EMULATOR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  wait "$TASK_EMULATOR_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  TASK_EMULATOR_PID=""
  printf "=== EMULATOR SHUTDOWN END ===\n"
}
trap stop_emulator EXIT

printf "SOURCE_ROOT=%s\n" "$SOURCE_ROOT"
printf "SOURCE_BRANCH=%s\n" "$(git -C "$SOURCE_ROOT" branch --show-current)"
printf "SOURCE_HEAD=%s\n" "$(git -C "$SOURCE_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf "SOURCE_TREE=%s\n" "$(git -C "$SOURCE_ROOT" rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
printf "NODE_VERSION=%s\n" "$(node --version)"
printf "INITIAL_DIFF_PATHS:\n"
git -C "$SOURCE_ROOT" diff --name-only

cd "$SOURCE_ROOT"
run_step "FULL_VITEST" npm test -- --run
FULL_VITEST_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS

run_step "PRODUCTION_BUILD" npm run build
PRODUCTION_BUILD_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS

if [ "$PRODUCTION_BUILD_STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then
  run_step "ANDROID_ASSET_SYNC_OR_COPY" ./node_modules/.bin/cap sync android
  ANDROID_ASSET_COPY_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS
else
  TASK_FAILURES=$((TASK_FAILURES + 1))
  printf "\n=== STEP SKIPPED: ANDROID_ASSET_SYNC_OR_COPY (PRODUCTION_BUILD_FAILED) ===\n"
fi

if [ "$ANDROID_ASSET_COPY_STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf "\n=== ANDROID EMULATOR START: Wave11_Android35 ===\n"
  "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd Wave11_Android35 -port 5554 -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  TASK_EMULATOR_PID=$!
  printf "EMULATOR_PID=%s\n" "$TASK_EMULATOR_PID"
  "$ADB" start-server >/dev/null
  run_step "ANDROID_EMULATOR_BOOT" wait_for_emulator
  if [ "$TASK_LAST_STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then
    "$ADB" -s emulator-5554 logcat -c
    cd "$SOURCE_ROOT/android"
    run_step "PID_CAPTURE_PERSISTENCE_READBACK_RESTART_SMOKE" ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=com.innovativenovels.app.ReadingJourneyInstrumentedTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.pidPersistenceProbeOnly=true
    PID_SMOKE_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS
    PID_CAPTURE_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS
    PID_PERSISTENCE_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS
    PID_READBACK_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS
    PROCESS_RESTART_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS
    printf "\n=== PID SMOKE LOG EVIDENCE ===\n"
    PID_SMOKE_LOGS="$("$ADB" -s emulator-5554 logcat -d -s NovelJourneyTest:I | /usr/bin/grep -E 'PID_CAPTURE=PASS|PID_PERSISTENCE=PASS|PID_READBACK=PASS|PROCESS_RESTART_PROVEN=PASS|NEW_PID=' || true)"
    printf "%s\n" "$PID_SMOKE_LOGS"
    if ! printf "%s\n" "$PID_SMOKE_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PID_CAPTURE=PASS'; then PID_CAPTURE_STATUS=1; fi
    if ! printf "%s\n" "$PID_SMOKE_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PID_PERSISTENCE=PASS'; then PID_PERSISTENCE_STATUS=1; fi
    if ! printf "%s\n" "$PID_SMOKE_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PID_READBACK=PASS'; then PID_READBACK_STATUS=1; fi
    if ! printf "%s\n" "$PID_SMOKE_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PROCESS_RESTART_PROVEN=PASS'; then PROCESS_RESTART_STATUS=1; fi
    if [ "$PID_CAPTURE_STATUS" -ne 0 ] || [ "$PID_PERSISTENCE_STATUS" -ne 0 ] || [ "$PID_READBACK_STATUS" -ne 0 ] || [ "$PROCESS_RESTART_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
      TASK_FAILURES=$((TASK_FAILURES + 1))
    fi

    "$ADB" -s emulator-5554 logcat -c
    run_step "ANDROID_NATIVE_PROCESS_RESTART_AND_RESUME" ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest
    ANDROID_NATIVE_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS
    printf "\n=== CANONICAL JOURNEY LOG EVIDENCE ===\n"
    CANONICAL_LOGS="$("$ADB" -s emulator-5554 logcat -d -s NovelJourneyTest:I | /usr/bin/grep -E 'PID_CAPTURE=PASS|PID_PERSISTENCE=PASS|PID_READBACK=PASS|PROCESS_RESTART_PROVEN=PASS|NEW_PID=|READER_RESUME_AFTER_RESTART=PASS' || true)"
    printf "%s\n" "$CANONICAL_LOGS"
    if [ "$ANDROID_NATIVE_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && printf "%s\n" "$CANONICAL_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PID_CAPTURE=PASS' && printf "%s\n" "$CANONICAL_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PID_PERSISTENCE=PASS' && printf "%s\n" "$CANONICAL_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PID_READBACK=PASS' && printf "%s\n" "$CANONICAL_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'PROCESS_RESTART_PROVEN=PASS' && printf "%s\n" "$CANONICAL_LOGS" | /usr/bin/grep -q 'READER_RESUME_AFTER_RESTART=PASS'; then
      READER_RESUME_STATUS=0
    else
      READER_RESUME_STATUS=1
      TASK_FAILURES=$((TASK_FAILURES + 1))
    fi
  else
    TASK_FAILURES=$((TASK_FAILURES + 1))
    printf "\n=== ANDROID TEST STEPS SKIPPED: EMULATOR_BOOT_FAILED ===\n"
  fi
else
  TASK_FAILURES=$((TASK_FAILURES + 1))
  printf "\n=== ANDROID TEST STEPS SKIPPED: ANDROID_ASSET_SYNC_FAILED ===\n"
fi

cd "$SOURCE_ROOT"
run_step "DIFF_CHECK" git diff --check
DIFF_CHECK_STATUS=$TASK_LAST_STATUS

printf "\nFULL_VITEST_STATUS=%s\n" "$FULL_VITEST_STATUS"
printf "PRODUCTION_BUILD_STATUS=%s\n" "$PRODUCTION_BUILD_STATUS"
printf "ANDROID_ASSET_COPY_STATUS=%s\n" "$ANDROID_ASSET_COPY_STATUS"
printf "PID_SMOKE_STATUS=%s\n" "$PID_SMOKE_STATUS"
printf "PID_CAPTURE_STATUS=%s\n" "$PID_CAPTURE_STATUS"
printf "PID_PERSISTENCE_STATUS=%s\n" "$PID_PERSISTENCE_STATUS"
printf "PID_READBACK_STATUS=%s\n" "$PID_READBACK_STATUS"
printf "PROCESS_RESTART_STATUS=%s\n" "$PROCESS_RESTART_STATUS"
printf "ANDROID_NATIVE_STATUS=%s\n" "$ANDROID_NATIVE_STATUS"
printf "READER_RESUME_STATUS=%s\n" "$READER_RESUME_STATUS"
printf "DIFF_CHECK_STATUS=%s\n" "$DIFF_CHECK_STATUS"
printf "FINAL_HEAD=%s\n" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf "FINAL_TREE=%s\n" "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}')"
printf "FINAL_STATUS:\n"
git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all
if [ "$TASK_FAILURES" -eq 0 ] && [ "$FULL_VITEST_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$PRODUCTION_BUILD_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ANDROID_ASSET_COPY_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$PID_CAPTURE_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$PID_PERSISTENCE_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$PID_READBACK_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$PROCESS_RESTART_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ANDROID_NATIVE_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$READER_RESUME_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && [ "$DIFF_CHECK_STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf "ALL_REQUIRED_GATES_PASS=YES\n"
  exit 0
fi
printf "ALL_REQUIRED_GATES_PASS=NO\n"
exit 1
